entries.id: apps/api/src/tests/query-perf/scheduled-run.postgres.test.ts::scheduled export measurement (postgres) > export measurement executes auto / transitions once without replaying writes
entries.reason: Failed on two pull requests that change no export code (runs 43587536394, 43591313231) while merge groups on the same main pass: the queued-export key reads go from 19 and 13 pages at 6,000 rows to 320 each at 12,000, so the doubling budget fails (455 vs 1065, at most 564). The plan depends on planner state; the read needs a plan that stays bounded.

entries.id: apps/api/src/tests/query-perf/scheduled-run.postgres.test.ts::scheduled export measurement (postgres) > export measurement executes force_generic_plan / transitions once without replaying writes
entries.reason: The same doubling-budget failure as the quarantined auto / transitions case (455 vs 1065 pages, at most 564) on a pull request that changes no export code (job 132566648596), while main passes. The queued-export key read needs a plan that stays bounded under a generic plan too.

entries.id: apps/web/src/routes/law/-law-home/law-recent.dom.test.tsx::a delayed second-client import cannot restore history cleared by the first client
entries.reason: Times out at the 5 s fast-suite limit under parallel load on main as well as on branches, together with the retry case in the same file; it mounts two server-history clients and needs a lighter fixture.

entries.id: packages/scripts/src/decision-reader-boundary.test.ts::source imports never reference any removed reader module
entries.reason: The test globs every source file and then reads each one; in a turbo run at concurrency 2 the @stll/mcp-apps test regenerates packages/mcp-apps/src/generated/bundles.ts in between, so the read can find the file gone (ENOENT in run job 132545465662). The scan needs to skip files that vanish after the glob or read a stable file list.
